name: S-Class Ardent
body:
What are S-Class Characters?

S-class characters began as a Patreon request from one of our backers, Kenneth Zike. They are built using the summoner class—as originally presented for the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game 1st Edition—as the basis against which all other classes are balanced.

The “S” in this case stands for both summoner and, as a more appropriate in-world reference, superior. If you have played, or GM’d for, a summoner and felt it was fine as is, you should have no problem running with an s-class character.

Spell-Like and Psi-Like Abilities

As explained in the source material, psionics function in many ways like spells, and are able to be countered, negated, and resisted just as spells are. The distinctions drawn between the two are purely in the ways in which they are learned and how they affect the world around them.

For this reason, the content here is provided more in context of other Pathfinder options, listing spell-like abilities and referring to spells when a psionic power or talent is equivalent to one.

S-class ardents are anomalies of existence; blending concepts of reality in ways that at once break them and give them their fullest representation. They are living enigmas; psionically gifted individuals whose understanding of the fundamental universe is nigh-unmatched.

Note: The s-class ardent is an alternate, superior version of the ardent class. It gains all of the same class features at the expected levels, so choosing an archetype is just as easy as for the standard class.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d8.

Starting Wealth: 3d6 × 10 gp (average 107 gp.)

Class Skills

The s-class ardent’s class skills are Autohypnosis (Wis), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Fly (Dex), Knowledge (All) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Profession (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Swim (Str). Each of an s-class ardent’s mantles grants her an additional class skill.

Skill Ranks per Level: 4 + Int modifier.

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the s-class ardent.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

An s-class ardent is proficient with all simple weapons, plus the hand crossbow, rapier, sap, shortbow, and short sword. They are also proficient with light and medium armor, and with shields (but not tower shields).

Power Points

An s-class ardent’s ability to manifest powers is limited by the power points she has available. Her base daily allotment of power points is given on Table: Ardent. In addition, she receives bonus power points per day if she has a high Wisdom score. Her ancestry or heritage might also provide bonus power points per day, as might certain feats and items.

Powers Known

S-class ardents create their class power list from the mantles they choose as they gain levels in the ardent class. An s-class ardent begins play knowing two ardent powers chosen from the list of powers granted by her mantles. Each time she achieves a new level, the ardent can choose an additional power from that list. An s-class ardent can manifest any power that has a power point cost equal to or lower than her manifester level.

The total number of powers an s-class ardent can manifest in a day is limited only by her daily power points.

An s-class ardent simply knows her powers; they are ingrained in her mind. She does not need to prepare them (in the way that some spellcasters prepare their spells), though she must get a good night’s sleep each day to regain all her spent power points.

The Difficulty Class for saving throws against ardent powers is 10 + the power’s level + the ardent’s Wisdom modifier

Maximum Power Level Known: To learn or manifest a power, an s-class ardent must have a Wisdom score of at least 10 + the power’s level.

Talents (Sp)

An s-class ardent begins play with both 0-level powers from each of her mantles. Each time she gains a new mantle, she also gains both of that mantle’s talents and adds them to her list.

Expanded Knowledge: If an s-class ardent gains a power by taking the Expanded Knowledge feat, that power may be chosen from any power list, even those of other classes. If the feat is used to take a power which is associated with a psionic mantle, the bonus power may be excluded from calculations of primary and secondary mantle power totals whenever doing so is advantageous.

Psionic Mantles

At 1st level, an s-class ardent chooses two mantles that represent the fundamental concepts of her existence. Once these choices are made, they cannot be changed. Each mantle grants the ardent the following benefits.

A class skill if she doesn’t have it already.
Access to the power list associated with that mantle.
Access to each mantle’s focal ability. She chooses one focal ability from her mantles at 1st level, and gains the other at 3rd level. From 6th level on, she gains the focal ability from each of her mantles when she selects them.
A selection of insights from which she can choose when she gains that feature beginning at 3rd level.

An s-class ardent can select any mantle she wants, even those that are diametrically opposed to each other, such as creation and destruction. S-class ardents that represent such concepts might live to keep them in balance, or they might express themselves as a living contradiction of reality. As an s-class ardent experiences reality, her existence becomes more complex, and her understanding of fundamental concepts grows. At 6th level, and every 3 levels thereafter, the ardent chooses an additional mantle that helps define her existence, to a maximum of 7 mantles at 18th level. This allows an s-class ardent seeking a true balance of reality within herself to select a total of three powers from each of her mantles by 20th level.

A selection of 26 mantles can be found at the end of this section.

Complex Existence (Ex)

An s-class ardent’s existence is a complex tangle of fundamental concepts that shape who she is and how she interacts with reality.

At 2nd level, this allows an s-class ardent to add her Wisdom bonus (if any) to her AC and CMD when unarmored, not using a shield, unencumbered, and conscious. If she is wearing armor or using a shield, she instead adds half her Wisdom bonus to her AC (minimum 0).

Beginning at 4th level, the ardent’s existence grows more complex, granting her a +1 bonus to her AC and CMD. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 ardent levels thereafter (up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level).

These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks and when the ardent is flat-footed. She loses these bonuses when she is immobilized or helpless.

Ardent levels stack with monk levels, and levels in any class that gains a similar AC bonus (such as shifters) when determining the increased bonus the ardent gains to AC. The bonuses themselves, as well as the added ability score modifier, do not stack.

Mantle Insights

At 3rd level, an s-class ardent gains greater insight into her mantles in the form of a special ability she can choose from among them.

She gains additional insights at 4th level, and every even level thereafter.

Greater and Superior Insights: Beginning at 8th level, an s-class ardent can select greater insights. Beginning at 14th level, she can select superior insights. In order to select a greater or superior insight within a mantle, the ardent must have all previous insights granted by that mantle first.

Retraining Insights: When she gains an s-class ardent level, the ardent can choose to learn a new insight for which she meets any prerequisites or requirements in place of one she already knows.

In effect, the ardent loses the old insight in exchange for the new one. She may swap only a single insight at any given level, and must choose whether or not to swap the insight at the same time that she gains new powers known for the level. Alternatively, she can spend one day of down time meditating on a new insight, two days on a greater insight, or three days on a superior insight.

These days need not be consecutive, but must be completed in one-day increments.

Attuned Skills (Ex)

At 5th level, an s-class ardent becomes a master of her mantles’ associated skills. She can take 10 on skill checks when using her mantles’ associated skills in which she has ranks. An s-class ardent can choose not to take 10 and can instead roll normally.

In addition, once per day, the ardent can take 20 on any mantle’s associated skill check as a standard action. She can use this ability one additional time per day for every six levels she possesses beyond 5th, to a maximum of three times per day at 17th level.

Improved Attuned Skill (Ex)

Beginning at 7th level, when an s-class ardent makes a skill check using one of her mantles’ associated skills, she can expend her psionic focus to roll 1d6 and add that value to her check. She can use this after rolling the check, but before learning the result, and she can use it even when taking 10 or 20.

At 13th level, the ardent rolls 2d4 instead, and at 19th level, she rolls 2d6.

Swift Insight (Ex)

At 15th level, an s-class ardent can glean insight from reality more quickly. She can retrain any mantle insight by spending 1 minute meditating on the new insight for which she meets any prerequisites or requirements.

Perfect Insight (Ex)

At 20th level, an s-class ardent selects a number of her mantles’ insights up to her Wisdom modifier. While she maintains her psionic focus, she can spend one full round meditating to swap one of the insights she knows for one of the chosen insights.

While meditating in this way, the ardent can take no other actions, but retains her AC bonus from complex existence (unless she loses that bonus for another reason). If she has evasion or any other ability that doesn’t function while she is helpless, she retains those abilities as well, unless she would lose them for another reason.

Psionic Mantles
Divinity

In many creation myths, reality wouldn’t exist without the intervention of the gods. Through their divine will, all things were made. Once you understand that, your beliefs grant you access to the divine firmament, from which you can draw great power.

Associated Skill: Diplomacy

Divine Domain (Focal Ability)

When you select this psionic mantle, choose one deity you have studied or worshiped. You gain one of that deity’s domains of your choice. This grants you only the powers associated with that domain. You do not gain the deity’s divine spells.

Domain Manifestations (Sp, Insight)

Choose up to three spells from your domains. You can manifest those spells as psionic powers of the same level.

You can select this insight multiple times.

Secondary Domain (Greater Insight)

You gain a second domain from your chosen deity.

Touch of Divinity (Su, Superior Insight)

As an immediate action, you can expend your psionic focus and gain one of the following benefits. You can do this a number of times per day equal to the number of divinity insights you have.

A creature’s missed attack roll to become a hit.
A creature’s hit becomes a critical threat.
A critical threat becomes a critical hit.
A failed ability or skill check succeeds as if the one attempting it met the DC.
A successful ability or skill check succeeds as if the one attempting it succeeded by 5 more than the DC.
A failed ability or skill check fails as if the one attempting it missed the DC by 5.
A successful ability or skill check fails as if the one attempting it missed the DC by 1.
A successful saving throw becomes a failed saving throw.
A failed saving throw becomes a successful saving throw.
Mantle Powers

0th—empathy, lesser fortify; 1st—natural healing, precognition; 2nd—body purification, empathic transfer; 3rd—fate link, withstand as one; 4th—augured answer, aura sight; 5th—psionic revivify; 6th—cleanse spirit; 7th—cosmic awareness; 8th—recall death; 9th—reality revision

Pain and Suffering

The potential for pain and suffering exist within all members of reality. Some draw pleasure from them, either as the creator or the recipient. Once you understand that, you can reflect on both, managing your own feelings and drawing them out of others.

Associated Skill: Heal

Shared Pain (Su, Focal Ability)

While you maintain your psionic focus, you can use a standard action to form an empathic link with a single living creature you are aware of within 30 feet of you. While the link persists, you can use an immediate action to deal damage to yourself or the other creature up to 1/2 your ardent level (minimum 1 damage). If you do, the other member of your link regains hit points equal to the damage dealt. As a standard action, you can expend your psionic focus and deal damage equal to twice your ardent level instead, then the link breaks.

Unwilling creatures can attempt a Will save against your shared pain every time you attempt to deal damage to them through your empathic link. A creature that succeeds on its save breaks the link and can’t be targeted by your shared pain again for 24 hours.

Bloodletting (Ex, Insight)

Whenever you threaten a creature with a critical hit with a piercing or slashing weapon (regardless of whether you confirm the critical hit or not), you cause that creature to bleed, making it take 1 point of bleed damage at the beginning of each round thereafter. This bleed damage increases by 1 for every additional pain and suffering insight you possess.

Bi-Directional Pain (Ex, Greater Insight)

Willing creature sharing your empathic link can use their own immediate actions for pain and suffering, but only to take damage and heal you. Any member of your empathic link can choose to take damage up to your ardent level instead. An unwilling creature that fails its save against your shared pain is staggered for 1 round.

Pain Network (Ex, Superior Insight)

When you use shared pain, you can form an empathic link with a number of creatures up to your Wisdom modifier within 60 feet of you instead. Once the link is established, it persists to a maximum distance of 400 feet plus 40 feet per ardent level. As a standard action, you can expend your psionic focus and deal damage to one creature that shares your empathic link equal to 1/2 your ardent level x the number of other creatures that share your empathic link. If you do, each of those creatures regains its own share of those hit points. Excess hit points gained in this way by a single creature are not redistributed to other creatures; they are lost.

Unwilling creatures that save against your shared pain can be targeted again after 1d4 rounds.

Mantle Powers

0th—induce pain, sicken body; 1st—demoralize, unearthly terror; 2nd—inflict pain, empathic transfer; 3rd—forced share pain, hostile empathic transfer; 4th—empathic feedback, moment of terror; 5th—induce nightmare; 6th—fuse flesh; 7th—psychosis; 8th—recall death; 9th—affinity field

Physical Power

The body is necessary for physical beings to exist within reality.

It anchors them, provides various stimuli, and allows them to better express other concepts; but it comes at a price. Once you understand that, you begin to discover ways to push yourself further, harder, faster. Fighting against exhaustion, weakness, and even death by building your physical stamina and power.

Associated Skill: Acrobatics

Psionic Mutation (Su, Focal Ability)

While you maintain your psionic bonus, you can meditate for one hour on the presence of endorphins and other hormones within your body. At the end of that hour, Choose Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. As a move action, you can expend your psionic focus and gain a +4 alchemical bonus to the selected ability score for 10 minutes per ardent level. In addition, while the mutation is in effect, you take a –2 penalty to one of your mental ability scores. If you enhanced your Strength, you take a penalty to your Intelligence. If you enhance your Dexterity, you take a penalty to your Wisdom. If you enhance your Constitution, you take a penalty to your Charisma.

Once you have used psionic mutation, you must meditate for another hour before you can use it again.

You can select the alchemist’s greater mutagen discovery as a greater insight, and the grand mutagen discovery as a superior insight. The benefits of those mutagens apply to your psionic mutation.

Powerful Build (Ex, Insight)

Your physical stature increases by half again your normal size. This lets you function in many ways as if you were one size category larger. Your space and reach are unchanged, but you can still be affected by powers, abilities, and spells that change your size category.

You gain a +1 size bonus on combat maneuver checks and to your CMD.
You are considered to be one size larger when determining whether a creature’s special attacks based on size (such as grab or swallow whole) can affect you.
You can use weapons designed for a creature one size larger without penalty.
Peak Physical Form (Ex, Greater Insight)

You have greater control over your stamina, gait, and general balance. Increase your all of your speeds by 10 feet. If you don’t have a climb speed or a swim speed, you gain one at 10 feet.

Nigh-Invulnerable (Ex, Superior Insight)

You gain DR 3/–. If you select this again, it increases to DR 5/–.

Mantle Powers

0th—lesser fortify, vim; 1st—expansion, hammer; 2nd—painful strike, resist toxin; 3rd—mental barrier, physical acceleration; 4th—backlash, thundering step; 5th—psychofeedback; 6th—brutalize wounds; 7th—fission; 8th—body of iron; 9th—timeless body

The Planes

The planes exist as an extension of reality, a million puzzle pieces that come together in one perfect formation. That the two can sometimes overlap is a marvel, creating planar events, beings, and objects. Once you understand that, your senses open and seek those subtle differences in reality so that you can control them.

Associated Skill: Handle Animal

Plane-Touched (Ex, Focal Ability)

When you select this mantle, you gain physical traits that mark you as extraplanar, such as monochomatic eyes, heightened features, or other minor effects. Your creature type counts as outsider with the native subtype when it would benefit you.

Creatures trying to affect you based on your type or subtype (such as a ranger’s favored enemy) must be able to target both your original type and outsiders with the native subtype to affect you, unless you choose to allow the effect to happen as a free action.

As a swift action, you can expend your psionic focus to grant a number of willing creatures up to your Wisdom modifier the benefits of this focal ability. This is a supernatural, polymorph effect for those creatures, and it lasts up to 1 minute per ardent level. A creature benefiting from plane-touched in this way can dismiss it as a free action.

Detect Planar Entity (Su, Insight)

At will, you can detect the presence of summoned creatures and items, ethereal creatures, and outsiders without the native subtype. This functions as detect magic, but only for the things mentioned here.

As a move action, you can concentrate on a single item or individual creature within 60 feet to determine if it meets the criteria above, learning any remaining duration it has (if any), or the strength of its aura as if having studied it for 3 rounds. While focusing on one individual or object, you do not detect other planar entities within range.

Detect Planar Event (Su, Greater Insight)

Your ability to detect planar entities can now also detect the use of teleportation magic or psionic psychoportation as a creature leaves or just before it arrives. If you are within 60 feet of where a creature will teleport or appear after teleporting, you become aware of its presence immediately as long as you are not focusing on an individual or object and can use a free action to call attention to it.

Creatures that have recently teleported and areas where such an effect has occurred leave their aura to detect and potentially track using Knowledge (planes) in place of Survival (all other effects that benefit tracking, such as the ranger’s track and swift tracker class features apply normally).

Planar Manipulation (Sp, Superior Insight)

While you maintain your psionic focus, you can manifest the following spell effects as psionic powers of the same level.

dimension door (4th), dismissal (5th), getaway (6th), banishment (7th), dimensional lock (8th), gate (9th)

Mantle Powers

0th—ectoplasmic trinket, telekinetic punch; 1st—astral traveler, hidden pocket; 2nd—dimension swap, ephemeral bolt; 3rd—astral caravan, gravitational anchor; 4th—expulsion, wrench; 5th—planar travel; 6th—genesis; 7th—ethereal form; 8th—astral seed; 9th—greater ethereal form

Repose

Rest is key to all forms of recovery. One’s body cannot hold up to constant rigors and stress. Eventually, it will simply give up.

Once you understand that, you can more accurately track your body’s needs and ability to persist for longer before you give it a break.

Associated Skill: Sense Motive

Conscious Effort (Ex, Focal Ability)

You add your Wisdom score to your Constitution score when determining how long you can hold your breath. You also do not need sleep, but must remain at ease for the normal amount of time to regain spells and other abilities that require rest (although you can perform light activity, such as reading or keeping watch).

Once you go without sleep for a total of seven consecutive nights, you are exhausted until you sleep for at least 8 hours.

Finally, before you attempt a saving throw, you can expend your psionic focus as an immediate action to roll that save twice and take either result. If the effect requiring the save deals any type of damage, you take no damage on a successful save, and only half damage on a failed save.

Serene Presence (Ex, Insight)

Your body has optimized its control of various mental and physical illnesses. Choose one type of affliction. You are immune to afflictions of that type, including supernatural and magical afflictions.

You can select this insight multiple times.

Passive Existence (Su, Greater Insight)

Your serene presence becomes nearly impossible to detect with magic. You gain a constant nondetection effect.

Perfect Repose (Su, Superior Insight)

You are no longer required to breathe or eat, but can do so if it would grant you a benefit, such as consuming a potion. You need only sleep 2 hours per day to gain the benefit of 8 hours of sleep (including with conscious effort). This allows you to recover your power points after only 2 hours, but does not allow you to recover them more than once per day.

Mantle Powers

0th—conceal thoughts, detect psionics; 1st—empty mind, slumber; 2nd—brain lock, sustenance; 3rd—delayed response, guarded sleep; 4th—immovability, mindwipe; 5th—fiery discorporation; 6th—suspend life; 7th—ensconce; 8th—astral seed; 9th—timeless body

Time

Time is a construct, an arbitrary measure created by mortal cultures. Once you understand that, you begin to see the flaws in it. The idea that time moves ever-forward, yet affects some more quickly than others allows you to manipulate it to your advantage.

Associated Skill: Sleight of Hand

Nick of Time (Su, Focal Ability)

You get periodic flashes, seconds into the future, that don’t allow you to avoid danger, but can help you adapt to it quickly.

While maintaining your psionic focus, you gain a bonus on initiative checks equal to 2 + 1 for every 3 ardent levels you possess beyond 1st (4th, 7th, and so on), to a maximum of +8 at 19th level.

When you would take damage or suffer from a negative effect, you can expend your psionic focus as an immediate action to instead delay it until the end of your next turn. On your turn, you can use a move action to delay it again. You can do this for a number of rounds up to your Wisdom modifier. When you finally take the damage or suffer from the effect, it occurs exactly as it would have when you were first affected by it and can’t be resisted or reduced by effects that occurred after. This allows you to prepare to treat or prepare for the effect, but not to negate it.

Temporal Awareness (Su, Insight)

You can always act in the surprise round even if you fail a Perception check to notice foes, but you are still considered flatfooted until you take an action.

Time is a River (Sp, Greater Insight)

Once per day, as a standard action, you can create a haste or slow effect. This functions as the spell of the same name, and your caster level with the spell is equal to your ardent level.

You can select this greater insight multiple times.

Time is On My Side (Su, Superior Insight)

You gain the benefit of greater age resistance while maintaining your psionic focus. You also gain the shapeshifter subtype. As a standard action, you can alter your physical appearance to look like you’re an adult, middle-aged, old, or venerable. This otherwise counts as the effects of wizened appearance if you become older, or youthful appearance if you become younger.

Mantle Powers

0th—distract, psionic repair; 1st—deceleration, déjà vu; 2nd—recall agony, sensitivity to psychic impressions; 3rd—improved response, time hop; 4th—mirror shot, quintessence; 5th—restore extremity; 6th—temporal acceleration; 7th—fission; 8th—mass time hop; 9th—time regression

Verve

The drive behind art, beauty, and creativity is verve. It is through verve that performances find audiences, actors find fans, and bards entertain kings. Once you understand that, you find an ember of creativity that you can spark into a roaring flame.

Associated Skill: Perform

Muse (Su, Focal Ability)

While you maintain your psionic focus, you gain a bonus on all Perform checks equal to 1/2 your ardent level (minimum +1).

You can take 10 on Perform checks, even if stress and distractions would normally prevent you from doing so.

As a standard action, you can expend your psionic focus and create an inspire courage effect, which functions as the bardic performance of the same name, except the bonuses you grant don’t increase beyond +1. This effect lasts for a total number of rounds per day up to your Wisdom modifier + twice your ardent level. These rounds need not be used consecutively.

Courageous Muse (Ex, Insight)

You can expend your psionic focus to inspire courage with muse as a move action. When you do, the bonuses you grant increase as if you were a bard of your ardent level (at 5th, 11th, and 17th level).

Competent Muse (Ex, Greater Insight)

You can expend your psionic focus to inspire courage with muse as a swift action. In addition, when you expend your psionic focus in this way, you can choose instead to create an inspire competence effect, which functions as the bardic performance of the same name, except it only works with your mantles’ associated skills, and the bonus you grant doesn’t increase beyond +3.

Power List

Inflict Pain: Give foe –4 on attack rolls, or –2 with save.

Recall Agony: Foe takes 2d6 damage.

Resist Toxin: Your body becomes temporarily immune to poison.

Sensitivity to Psychic Impressions: Learn an area’s history.

Sustenance: Go without food and water for one day.

3rd-Level Powers

Astral Caravan: Lead an astral caravan.

Battlesense: Mental display allows for improved teamwork.

Empathic Transfer, Hostile: Your touch transfers your hurt.

Fate Link: You link the fates of two targets.

Gravitational Anchor: Alter gravity toward a creature or object.

Guarded Sleep: Subject’s mind is protected while asleep.

Mental Barrier: Gain +4 bonus to AC until your next action.

Physical Acceleration: Gain +1 on attacks, AC, and Reflex saves.

Time Hop: Subject hops forward in time 1 round/level.

4th-Level Powers

Augured Answer: Provides advice for specific proposed action.

Aura Sight: Reveals selected alignment axis.

5th-Level Powers

Induce Nightmare: Sends vision dealing 1d10 damage, fatigue.

Planar Travel: Travel to other planes.

Psionic Revivify: Return the dead to life.

Psychofeedback: Boost one physical ability score.

Restore Extremity: Return a lost appendage to subject.

6th-Level Powers

Brutalize Wounds: Target takes more damage than normal.

Suspend Life: put yourself in a state akin to suspended animation.

Temporal Acceleration: Your time frame accelerates for 1 round.

7th-Level Powers

Cleanse Spirit: Restores level and ability score drains.

Cosmic Awareness: Gain bonus on one attack roll, check, or save.

Fission: You briefly duplicate yourself.

8th-Level Powers

Body of Iron: Your body becomes living iron.

9th-Level Powers

Affinity Field: Effects that affect you also affect others.

Timeless Body: Ignore all effects for 1 round.

Power Descriptions

The following powers are summarized for easy reference. For additional details, please refer to the source material.

0-Level Powers
Conceal Thoughts

Psionic Focus or 1 Power Point

Discipline telepathy [mind-affecting]; Level 0

Display mental

Manifesting Time 1 standard action

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target(s) one willing creature

Duration 1 hour/level

Saving Throw Will (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

The target gains a +10 circumstance bonus on Bluff checks against those attempting to discern its true intentions with Sense Motive. It also gains a +4 bonus on saves against any power or spell used to read its mind (such as mind probe or read thoughts).

You can select this greater insight twice. If you do, you can inspire competence in any appropriate skill (as described by that ability), and the bonus increases as if you were a bard of your ardent level.

Heroic Muse (Ex, Superior Insight)

As a swift action, you can expend your psionic focus to create either an inspire greatness effect on up to two creatures, or an inspire heroics effect on one creature. These effects function as the bardic performances of the same names, except you can’t increase the number of targets.
